aquaculture.method: Indoor tank culture of the species through a full generation. Adult male and female plants were sampled in April 2007 at Xiaohuyu, Nanji Islands (27 27 N, 121 04 E), flown to the laboratory in Qingdao within 24 h and precultured in 80 L flow-through polypropylene tanks in tumble culture under reduced solar irradiance. Zygotes were collected on 6 June from one female plant and seeded onto a 0.5 m2 seedling collector; the seedlings were grown to 5-7 cm, re-inserted into a 2 cm nylon/cotton rope and grown on in a 1,000 L flow-through indoor raceway tank (lanes 400 x 40 x 40 cm, sand-filtered and ozone-treated water, 50% renewed daily, KNO3 10 and KH2PO4 1 mg/L every two days, long-lines hung at the surface at 15 cm intervals). The paper reports that the seedlings reached the long-line cultivation stage and that the life cycle in culture was completed in 4.5 months.
